notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other Orc and/or Shaman.
description:
Cast Baral's Expertise by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it to your hand, copying Baral's Expertise.
Resolve the copy of Baral's Expertise, returning up to three artifacts and/or creatures to their owner's hand and casting Rootha without paying its mana cost.
Rootha enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding at least {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.
 If you control two other Orcs and/or Shamans, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.
